page_title: DAR 3-3 MON | Darmstadt v B. Monchengladbach 17/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The match has just finished.
90+8' Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.

90+7' Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Marcel Schuhen. This effort really didn't trouble him.

90+5' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. The ball goes out of play and Darmstadt will have a goal kick.

90+3' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low shot was directed into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
90' Marcel Schuhen makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded by Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) after a cross from the side.
88' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
87' Marcel Schuhen (Darmstadt) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
85' Marcel Schuhen (Darmstadt) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
85' Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.

85' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. B. Monchengladbach are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
81' Torsten Lieberknecht has decided to substitute Tim Skarke and he is replaced by Aaron Seydel (Darmstadt).
81' A substitution has been made. Marvin Mehlem is replaced by Clemens Riedel (Darmstadt).
80' Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
78' Fabian Holland (Darmstadt) challenges for the lofted pass into the centre of the box, but has to stretch too much and sends his header narrowly wide of the left post.

77' 3 - 3 Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) quickly gets to a rebound. He is not worried how far out he is and slams the ball towards the goal. To the amazement of all, it goes inside the left post. He makes it 3:3 with this magnificent strike.
76' The attendance is 17810.

75' A dangerous towering header by Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the left post. This corner kick didn't change the score. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Darmstadt.
75' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) steps up to send the ball in.
73' 3 - 2 Goal! Tomas Cvancara gets to the ball and heads it over the defence to Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach), who meets it nicely and fires in into the back of the net. 3:2.
72' Torsten Lieberknecht has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Bartol Franjic (Darmstadt) replacing Luca Pfeiffer.
72' Here's the change. Tobias Kempe leaves the pitch and Thomas Poppler Isherwood (Darmstadt) comes on as a substitute.
69' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
68' None of the B. Monchengladbach players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.

67' A snap shot by Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) from the edge of the area flies towards the roof of the net, but Marcel Schuhen produces a good save to thwart him. B. Monchengladbach have been awarded a corner kick.
64' Marcel Schuhen (Darmstadt) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
62' Substitution. Rocco Reitz will be replaced by Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach).
62' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) takes it short.

61' Emir Karic (Darmstadt) latched on to an accurate pass just outside the box and immediately lashed the ball towards the top left corner. His effort was thwarted by Moritz Nicolas, who pulled off a stunning save. The ball goes out of play. Darmstadt are awarded a corner kick.
56' 3 - 1 Goal! Rocco Reitz plays a pass to the feet of Jordan Siebatcheu (B. Monchengladbach) and he shoots low into the back of the net from inside the box. It's 3:1.
55' Darmstadt can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
52' The corner is swung in but B. Monchengladbach can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
50' Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) sends the penalty to the bottom right corner, but Marcel Schuhen pulls off a wonderful save to deny him.
50' Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) is going to take the penalty!
49' We have witnessed a red card for Matej Maglica (Darmstadt).
49' The B. Monchengladbach players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
48' Referee Timo Gerach makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
47' Surely that's handball by one of the Darmstadt players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Marvin Friedrich (B. Monchengladbach) comes off for Nico Elvedi.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Gerardo Seoane probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach). He is replaced by Florian Neuhaus.
46' Gerardo Seoane has made a change at the break. Luca Netz has come on in place of Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach).
46' Gerardo Seoane makes a half-time substitution. Tomas Cvancara comes on in place of Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' Timo Gerach blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' A corner kick by Darmstadt is thwarted by the well prepared Moritz Nicolas (B. Monchengladbach).
45+3' Darmstadt take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. The ball goes out of play and Darmstadt have been awarded a corner kick.

45+2' Fabian Nurnberger (Darmstadt) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Moritz Nicolas stops the ball from going inside the left post. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Darmstadt.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
45' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Franck Honorat, but Marcel Schuhen displays great awareness to stop him.
44' Marcel Schuhen displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Jordan Siebatcheu (B. Monchengladbach) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
43' Maximilian Wober (B. Monchengladbach) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
41' Torsten Lieberknecht is forced to make a change. Matthias Bader is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Fabian Nurnberger (Darmstadt).
40' Luca Pfeiffer (Darmstadt) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Luca Pfeiffer (Darmstadt) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
39' The shot by Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Moritz Nicolas.
37' B. Monchengladbach are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.
33' 3 - 0 Goal! Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) fires the rebound inside the right post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 3:0.

31' What a great touch by Tim Skarke (Darmstadt)! He picks up a precise pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot on goal. His effort, however, only rattles the right post. What an unlucky moment for him.
29' Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.

27' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) finds some space on the edge of the box after some nice individual play and curls a shot in on goal, but the ball flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Darmstadt.
26' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) tries to find Joe Scally with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
23' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Darmstadt.
20' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.

19' The cross fools the defence and leaves Maximilian Wober (B. Monchengladbach) with an easy chance inside the box, but he mistimes his shot and sends it just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Darmstadt will have a goal kick.
18' Marvin Mehlem (Darmstadt) brings his opponent down. Timo Gerach has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
16' A quickly taken corner by Darmstadt.

15' Fabian Holland (Darmstadt) picks up a sweet pass and fires one in from distance towards the top of the goal, but Moritz Nicolas is alert and makes a decent save. Darmstadt force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
14' Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) is penalised for a foul. Timo Gerach had a clear view and blows his whistle.
11' The resulting set piece from B. Monchengladbach is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
10' 2 - 0 Matej Maglica (Darmstadt) scores from a seemingly difficult position as he leaps high to head home a cross, putting the ball beyond the reach of the goalkeeper.
9' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Darmstadt comes to nothing.

8' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Marvin Mehlem (Darmstadt) scores with a brilliant low shot into the middle of the goal after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Fabian Holland. The score is now 1:0.
6' Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) sends a cross into the box, but Moritz Nicolas comes off his line to gather the ball.
3' Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
